name: Fresh Meat
summary: Dar needs crawler legs from the coast for hungry customers in Orgrimmar.

sections.title: Crawler Legs for Orgrimmar
sections.body: Dar's customers in Orgrimmar crave crawler meat, especially from the monstrous crawlers. East of here, the creatures scurry over the beaches and into the surf. Bring back some of their legs, and Dar promises a cask of wine. He means to taste the meat before it goes on to Orgrimmar.

sections.title: A Taste for the Road
sections.body: Dar is pleased with the legs and pictures them cooked over an open fire. He urges you to take a cooked sample on your travels. Dar swears it is delicious.

faq.q: Who wants crawler meat in the Swamp of Sorrows?
faq.answer: Dar's customers in Orgrimmar have a high demand for crawler meat.

faq.q: Where are the monstrous crawlers located?
faq.answer: The monstrous crawlers scurry along the coast to the east, over the beaches and into the surf.

faq.q: Why does Dar need these specific legs?
faq.answer: Dar's customers crave crawler meat, especially from the monstrous crawlers. The legs are bound for Orgrimmar.
